{{Quote|Don't be in such a hurry, Blade. Don't you remember me? Your old buddy, Dheno Rey? You haven't aged well since we met up on Hoth. Your nose... and your skin! But you couldn't be an imposter--you know your friend Dheno.|Dheno Rey, to the "Red Blade"|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Dheno Rey''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
{{GameDS}}
Dheno Rey was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]]. According to Rey, he encountered the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] known as the [[Red Blade]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. Rey also claimed the Blade owed him [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="TOR" />

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], an [[Cipher Nine|agent]] of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]], disguised as the Red Blade, [[Mission to Hutta (Imperial Intelligence)|visited]] the planet [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Hutta]] to convince [[Suudaa Nem'ro|Nem'ro]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] to ally with the Empire. Rey heard about the "Red Blade" visiting Hutta, and later encountered the imposter inside [[Nem'ro's Palace]]. He told the [[Agent/Legends|agent]] they didn't resemble the Red Blade, whom Rey claimed owed him credits, and demanded a payment to keep from revealing they were an impostor. The [[Imperial Agent]] refused and [[Death/Legends|killed]] Rey.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
This article assumes dark side options are chosen, meaning the agent kills Dheno Rey.<ref name="TOR" />

He can be flirted with by a female Imperial Agent, who can either pay off Dheno when he insists on his collecting the credits or further seduce him into accepting [[Reproduction/Legends|other means]]. As a result he neither blows the agent's cover nor ends up killed.
